description: This is a Python source file defining classes and functions for generating C code related to test modules and suites, specifically for a project called 'clar'. It includes templates for code generation, module parsing, and test suite management.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a test module with methods for parsing test functions, rendering templates, and refreshing its state from a file.

classes.name: TestSuite
classes.description: Manages a collection of modules, handles loading, caching, enabling/disabling, and writing the test suite configuration.

methods.name: Module.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Module instance with a name.

methods.name: Module.clean_name
methods.description: Converts the module name by replacing underscores with '::'.

methods.name: Module._skip_comments
methods.description: Removes comments from C code content.

methods.name: Module.parse
methods.description: Parses test function definitions from source code content.

methods.name: Module.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes module data from a file, re-parsing if modified.

methods.name: TestSuite.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestSuite with a path and output directory.

methods.name: TestSuite.should_generate
methods.description: Determines if the suite should be generated based on file modification.

methods.name: TestSuite.find_modules
methods.description: Finds and returns modules in the specified path.

methods.name: TestSuite.save_cache
methods.description: Saves current module data to cache.

methods.name: TestSuite.suite_count
methods.description: Returns the count of test suites.

methods.name: TestSuite.callback_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of callbacks.

methods.name: TestSuite.write
methods.description: Generates the 'clar.suite' output file with module and callback info.
